notes: This is intentionally lightweight. Use as a stand-in for weekend triage and quick-handoff to oncall/SE. Rows are compact — expand in linked Jira tickets for execution details. Key constraints: keep fixes low-risk (no model retrains), prefer config patches, and isolate customer-impacting changes behind feature guards.
next_steps: 1) Confirm owners can commit to ETA within next 6 hours and update this sheet
2) For items marked in_progress — post the short mitigation plan to #ops-coverage and tag oncall
3) If ETA slips >48h, schedule a 15-minute sync with product-ops + responsible engineer
4) After closure, mark status=closed, paste JIRA link and brief root-cause note
5) Weekly retrospective: aggregate recurring blockers into backlog epics and assign product owner
